title: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
summary_raw: Google Deepmind tests the reliability of 18 AI models with "Humanity's First Exam." Top models solve nearly every task family at least once, but even leaders like OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra stumble when asked for 16 straight correct answers. Visual perception accounts for 73 percent of errors, and more compute time doesn't fix the problem. title: Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots
summary_raw: Embo raised $110 million in seed funding to build a universal robot brain with world models. Its AI learns how the physical world works from internet video and practices motor skills in simulation. Google Deepmind, Meta, and MIT researchers are behind the startup as the race for general-purpose robotics AI accelerates. summary_raw: OpenAI is suing Apple in a California court, accusing it of trade secret theft and of coercing shared suppliers. The countersuit follows Apple's own lawsuit from the summer. Just two years ago, the two companies teamed up to bring ChatGPT to the iPhone. Now OpenAI is building its own devices to compete directly with Apple. title: Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models
summary_raw: Yann LeCun is pushing forward with his alternative to language models through his startup AMI Labs. Three new studies show progress in robot planning, more efficient training, and error correction, though the pieces still need to grow together.
